description: S52 T2 (LM2): the human door takes a memory back. retract answers the row AS IT NOW STANDS — flagged retracted, with the instant and what the person said — plus changed:true, the act that moved it. The reason was required at the door (1..256); the stamp carries it, the audit line keeps its fixed template. A second retract of the same id answers the SAME row with changed:false and wrote nothing at all, not even an audit line (LM2's idempotence: a retraction of an already-retracted memory is not an act).
